| latitude, longitude | DOUBLE | Coordinates of the crash location |
| location | VARCHAR | Latitude/longitude pair |
| on_street_name | VARCHAR | Street on which the crash occurred |
| cross_street_name | VARCHAR | Nearest cross street |
| off_street_name | VARCHAR | Street address if known |

python3 << 'EOF'
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

# Create output directory
os.makedirs('./out', exist_ok=True)

# Query the data
conn = duckdb.connect()
query = """
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) as year,
    SUM(number_of_persons_killed) as total_killed
FROM './data/crashes.parquet'
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2025
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)
ORDER BY year
"""
df = conn.execute(query).fetchdf()
print(df)
print(f"\nTotal killed 2016-2025: {df['total_killed'].sum()}")

# Create the chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(df['year'], df['total_killed'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#d62728')
plt.fill_between(df['year'], df['total_killed'], alpha=0.1, color='#d62728')
plt.title('NYC Motor Vehicle Crash Fatalities by Year (2016-2025)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of People Killed', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.xticks(df['year'])
plt.tight_layout()

# Add value labels on points
for x, y in zip(df['year'], df['total_killed']):
    plt.annotate(f'{int(y):,}', (x, y), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0, 10), ha='center', fontsize=10)

plt.savefig('./out/fatalities_by_year.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print("\nChart saved to ./out/fatalities_by_year.png")
EOF
